outputs.explanation: Panel A is a 3D segmented/rendered model of the apical end of a sporozoite (preconoidal rings, actin filament) — a schematic/structural rendering, not a plot of averaged data, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
Panel B is a 3D rendering of the basal end showing cytoplasmic/pellicular actin and IMC — an illustrative structural model, not a plot, so no individual data points are required.
Panel C is a tomogram slice (micrograph) with highlighted filaments; it is raw imaging data, not a quantitative plot of averages, so the check does not apply.
Panel D is a 3D schematic/rendering of a lateral section showing nuclear, cytosolic and pellicular F-actin — an illustrative model, not a plot, so no individual data points are needed.
Panel E shows a slice through an averaged subtomogram volume of thin pellicular filaments — a structural/image average, not a plot with summary statistics, so the check does not apply.
Panel F is a tomogram slice (micrograph) showing a filament connected to a TPF by densities; it is raw imaging data, not a plot of averaged measurements, so no individual data points are required.
